subject.title: fix: land ten small reliability fixes

question: Should maintainers land this broad maintainer-labeled reliability batch after exact-head proof completes, or split/rework any subsystem whose mobile/auth/security validation does not finish cleanly?
rationale: The patch appears technically sound in source review, but it touches protected maintainer-owned surfaces with auth-provider and security-boundary behavior that automation should not accept without final human ownership.

options.title: Land after exact-head proof
options.body: Wait for hosted CI/Testbox/mobile proof on this head, then land the batch if the proof remains green and the fail-closed boundaries are accepted.

options.title: Split risky subsystems
options.body: If mobile or provider/security validation fails, split the affected subsystem into a narrower PR and keep the clean fixes moving separately.

options.title: Pause the batch
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers decide the combined review blast radius is too high for one landing candidate.

recommendation.title: Land after exact-head proof
recommendation.body: Wait for hosted CI/Testbox/mobile proof on this head, then land the batch if the proof remains green and the fail-closed boundaries are accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the batch and is the strongest current cross-surface owner in the file and PR history sampled.
